svg.title: Allegator Games logo introduction
svg.desc: The full Allegator Games name draws on in outlined lettering. Its real alligator A and G expand continuously into the final logo while the remaining letters retract into the initials and the back scales unfold.
svg.metadata: One-shot SVG animation. The completed outlined name holds for 1.3 seconds, then replace with the looping loader after 2400 milliseconds.
